content: Firebase App Hosting (Cloud Run based) reached GA in April 2025 and supports Next.js/Angular SSR; classic Firebase Hosting is static-file/CDN only (SPA-friendly with rewrites) and the old 'Hosting frameworks experiment' is closed to new participants in favor of App Hosting. Vercel remains the most mature Next.js SSR host but requires a second vendor/dashboard; user has no Vercel CLI installed.
